directAnswer: Check the bounce rates and unsubscribe rates in your mailing list software, and ensure your email content complies with anti-spam regulations.
summary: Troubleshooting a mailing list involves checking delivery issues, analyzing engagement metrics, and ensuring compliance with email regulations.

sections.heading: Check Delivery Issues
sections.body: Start by reviewing your email delivery reports to identify any bounce rates or delivery failures. Most mailing list platforms provide insights into these metrics.

sections.heading: Analyze Engagement Metrics
sections.body: Look at open rates, click-through rates, and unsubscribe rates to gauge how your audience is interacting with your emails.

sections.heading: Ensure Compliance with Regulations
sections.body: Verify that your emails include necessary elements like unsubscribe links and comply with regulations such as CAN-SPAM or GDPR.

steps.title: Review Bounce Reports
steps.detail: Access your mailing list platform's analytics section to find bounce reports and identify problematic email addresses.

steps.title: Check Spam Complaints
steps.detail: Look for spam complaint rates in your email campaign reports to see if recipients are marking your emails as spam.

steps.title: Update Email List
steps.detail: Regularly clean your email list by removing inactive or invalid email addresses to improve deliverability.

steps.title: Test Email Content
steps.detail: Send test emails to different email providers (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) to see how your emails are rendered and if they land in the inbox or spam folder.

faqs.question: What should I do if my emails keep going to spam?
faqs.answer: Ensure your email content is relevant, avoid spammy words, and authenticate your domain with SPF and DKIM.

faqs.question: How often should I clean my mailing list?
faqs.answer: It's recommended to clean your mailing list every 6-12 months, or more frequently if you notice high bounce rates.

faqs.question: What are the best practices for email subject lines?
faqs.answer: Keep subject lines concise, avoid excessive punctuation, and personalize where possible to increase open rates.

caveats: Email delivery issues can vary significantly between different email service providers.
Engagement metrics may be influenced by external factors such as seasonality or changes in audience preferences.
